entities.name: Lyese
entities.description: Green moon of Mirrodin, composed of green mana, ejected through the Radix.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: Named the moon after her sister.

entities.name: Lyese (sister of Glissa)
entities.description: Sister of Glissa for whom the moon was named.

entities.name: Sylvok
entities.description: Called the moon the True Sun.

entities.name: Goblins of Mirrodin
entities.description: Called the moon the Ugly Child.

entities.name: Fifth Dawn
entities.description: Event of the moon being ejected through the Radix.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion at whose end New Phyrexia phased out.

events.summary: Lyese is ejected through the Radix in the Fifth Dawn and named by Glissa after her sister.
events.quote: named by Glissa after her sister

events.summary: After New Phyrexia phases out at the end of the invasion, Lyese orbits Zhalfir.
events.quote: It now orbits Zhalfir after New Phyrexia's phasing out
